Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Narre Warren

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Narre Warren. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

Narre Warren has grown quickly, and we look after everything from the first-generation estate roofs through to the older homes around the township. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in Narre Warren: What We Commonly See

Narre Warren is one of the established hubs of the City of Casey, built out from the 1980s through the 2000s around the Fountain Gate town centre. That gives a real mix of roofs, from older brick-veneer homes to COLORBOND® steel across the newer estates. Set well inland, the roofs here deal with heat, harsh UV and the south-east's hailstorms rather than salt.

The jobs we are called out for most in Narre Warren are refixing cracked ridge capping, storm and hail damage, re-roofing ageing roofs, and replacing tired guttering and downpipes.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Narre Warren

Estate roofs are now old enough that a number of Narre Warren homes are due for a proper look. We re-roof and re-sheet homes in COLORBOND® steel, which is light, durable and suited to the south-east's hail and UV, and we can match the colour to your existing gutters and trims.

Thinking about going metal? We also handle tile to tin conversions, swapping a heavy, high-maintenance roof for lightweight metal. If your roof has widespread leaks, sagging or badly rusted sheeting, talk to us about a re-roof before you keep paying for patch jobs. We will give you a straight answer on what makes the most sense for your home and budget.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Narre Warren

Newer roofs still need a roof plumber now and then. Our registered roof plumbers reseal and refix flashings, valleys and ridge capping, and sort out undersized downpipes and overflowing gutters, which are the most common problems on estate homes after heavy rain or a storm.

Whether you need one section of guttering replaced or a full re-gutter with matching downpipes in COLORBOND® steel, we will quote it clearly and finish it neatly. Small jobs such as gutter repairs are no problem either.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Narre Warren

Your quote depends on what your roof actually needs. Roof size, pitch and access, the type of steel and colour you choose, and how much plumbing work is involved are the main factors. We give you a clear written quote after an on-site inspection, so you know what you are paying for before any work starts.

Our Narre Warren Roofing Process

It starts with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. Once you approve it we strip the existing roof, check and prepare the framing, then install new COLORBOND® steel sheeting, flashings and ridge capping, along with new guttering and downpipes where they are part of the job. Every job finishes with a clean site.

Why Narre Warren Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

Narre Warren locals choose Sandhurst Roofing because we turn up when we say we will, do quality work and charge a fair price. We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, and we explain what is happening every step of the way. Have a look at the COLORBOND® colour chart to start choosing your colour.

Narre Warren Roofing FAQs

My roof is fairly new. Do I still need a roof plumber?

Possibly. Newer roofs can still have poorly sealed flashings, undersized downpipes or storm damage. We can inspect the roof, reseal or refix what needs it and give you an honest opinion.

Can you fix hail and storm damage?

Yes. We fix dented sheeting, damaged flashings and storm-related leaks, and can advise whether a re-roof is the better option after major damage.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.
